Room for everyone

Accessibility statement

Our approach to making the café information and menu easier to use.

Using the website

This website is designed with semantic page landmarks, descriptive headings, a skip link, keyboard-operable navigation, visible focus indicators, labelled search, descriptive image text, and layouts that adapt to smaller screens. Motion is restrained and respects the reduced-motion preference.

Menu and gallery controls

The menu uses standard buttons and a search field, with the number of matching items announced as it changes. Category buttons expose their selected state. The photo viewer can be closed with its close button or the Escape key. Frequently asked questions use standard expandable controls.

Maps and alternatives

Google Maps is optional and loads only on request. The supplied location and telephone number remain available as text. External map content may have accessibility behaviour beyond this website’s control.

Accessibility feedback

If something prevents you from using the website, call 982-0347351 and describe the page and issue. A dedicated accessibility email has not been supplied.

Physical access

The physical accessibility of the premises, including step-free access, lifts, toilets, and seating arrangements, has not been confirmed. Please contact the café directly for information suited to your visit.

Ongoing review

This statement describes implementation features rather than certification. The café should review the live site with assistive technologies and confirm an accessibility feedback contact before launch.
